passages.title: Visitor Guide: Brightway Taoyuan Plant
lines: Welcome to our plant! Please read this guide before your visit.

The Brightway plant in Taoyuan opened in 2009. We started as a maker of electronic devices, and today we manufacture desk lamps for clients around the world. The installation of three new assembly lines last year doubled our capability. Today, about 300 people work here.

Every lamp is made to the client's specification. Our inspectors take samples from each line every two hours and test them in our own lab. Each measurement must be precise, and each lamp's weight must be right to within 5 grams. These strict tests keep our quality consistent.

Wear the protective gear and hard hat you are given. Stay inside the yellow lines, and do not touch any machine. Some machine parts are sharp, and some areas are narrow, so walk slowly. Stay away from areas with a danger sign or areas closed for maintenance. Every area is equipped with a fire extinguisher.
We recycle over 90% of our waste. The rest goes to a licensed company for disposal.
If you have any questions, ask the foreman or your guide. Thank you for visiting, and enjoy your tour!

questions.en: What did the plant add last year?
How often do inspectors take samples?
questions.zh: 檢驗員多久抽一次樣品？

questions.en: What are visitors asked not to do?
questions.zh: 參觀者被要求不能做什麼？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Did you get a chance to read the visitor guide I gave you?
scene.zh: 我給你的參觀手冊，你有空看了嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Check out the quality part. Our inspectors are really strict.
scene.zh: 看一下品質那一段。我們的檢驗員真的很嚴格。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I didn't realize you had your own testing lab here.
scene.zh: 我都不知道你們這裡有自己的測試實驗室。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 對啊，就在那片玻璃後面。他們什麼都量，精確到一公克。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Every lamp has to match the client's specifications exactly.
scene.zh: 每盞燈都必須完全符合客戶的規格。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That keeps the quality consistent.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ms. Varga will take us there after lunch.
scene.zh: 午餐後 Varga 廠長會帶我們過去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And that area is closed for maintenance, so don't go in.
scene.zh: 還有那一區在維修保養，不要進去。

lines.en: First, we test the arm. The mechanism has to open and close twenty thousand times.
lines.zh: 我們先測燈臂。這個機構要開關兩萬次。

lines.en: Twenty thousand? That must take a while.
lines.zh: 兩萬次？那一定要花不少時間。

lines.en: About two days. Over here, the lamps sit next to a heater for 48 continuous hours.
lines.zh: 大約兩天。這邊的燈要放在加熱器旁邊四十八小時。

lines.en: At a constant forty degrees, right?
lines.zh: 一直維持在四十度，對吧？

lines.en: That's right. We want to see if anything fails in extreme heat.
lines.zh: 沒錯。我們要看看在極端的高溫下會不會有東西故障。

lines.en: And what about the shade? It looks very thin.
lines.zh: 那燈罩呢？看起來很薄。

lines.en: It is, so a worker examines every shade by hand.
lines.zh: 是很薄，所以每個燈罩都由工人親手仔細檢查。

lines.en: A machine also detects small marks on the surface.
lines.zh: 另外還有機器會偵測表面上的小刮痕。

lines.en: Honestly, these lamps are durable. My old glass lamp at home is ten years old!
lines.zh: 說真的，這些燈很耐用。我家那盞舊的玻璃檯燈已經用十年了！

lines.en: Good to hear. So no problems so far?
lines.zh: 那就好。所以到目前為止都沒問題？

lines.en: None. We haven't seen anything unusual today.
lines.zh: 沒有。今天沒看到什麼不尋常的地方。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Every two hours. Then we examine each one.
scene.zh: 每兩個小時一次。然後我們會仔細檢查每一個。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 這台機器連表面上一個小刮痕都偵測得到。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What happens to a lamp if it fails the test?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We study the failure, and that lamp never leaves the plant.
scene.zh: 我們會研究故障的原因，而那盞燈絕對不會出廠。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 別擔心，這些燈真的很耐用。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 到目前為止，我們還沒發現什麼不尋常的地方。

textFills.title: Lantern bases: an update
lines: Our inspectors found a defect in one batch of lamp bases. This is ___ they found it: a machine detected small cracks on the surface.
We have suspended that part of the line. To avoid any more ___, we will use our old supplier's material as a substitute.
Normal work should be restored by next week. ___ This could potentially delay the first UK order by a week.
zh: 我們的檢驗員在一批燈座裡發現瑕疵。他們是這樣發現的：機器偵測到表面上有細小的裂痕。
我們已經暫停那一段產線。為了避免再被打亂，我們會改用原本供應商的材料來替代。
下週應該就能恢復正常。這些燈一盞都沒有出廠，所以不需要召回。這可能會讓第一批英國訂單晚一週。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We have a problem. Our inspectors found cracks in some bases.
scene.zh: 我們有個問題。檢驗員在一些燈座上發現了裂痕。

lines.en: These are the raw materials for the Lantern series.
lines.zh: 這些是 Lantern 系列的原料。

lines.en: The bases are natural wood from Taiwan, the arms are steel, and the shades are cloth.
lines.zh: 燈座是台灣的天然木頭，燈臂是鋼，燈罩是布。

lines.en: Every box shows its country of origin, so we always know where our materials come from.
lines.zh: 每個箱子上都標了產地，所以我們一直都知道材料是從哪裡來的。

lines.en: The wood is checked here before it goes to the line.
lines.zh: 木頭在送上產線之前，會先在這裡檢查。

lines.en: Now, a plant like ours uses a lot of energy.
lines.zh: 像我們這樣的工廠會用掉很多能源。

lines.en: So on top of the building, we make some of our own electricity from the sun.
lines.zh: 所以我們在大樓頂上用太陽能自己發一些電。

lines.en: That gives us about a third of all the electricity we consume.
lines.zh: 大約是我們用電量的三分之一。

lines.en: Our new machines are also more efficient. They use much less energy than conventional machines.
lines.zh: 我們的新機器也比較節能，用的能源比一般機器少很多。

lines.en: That's good for the environment, and it saves us money, too.
lines.zh: 這對環境好，也幫我們省錢。

lines.en: And metal parts that are left over are sent back to be used again.
lines.zh: 剩下來的金屬零件會送回去重新利用。

scene.zh: 我來問他。其他的可以上貨船。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ms. Varga, meet the Lantern coordinator from Harbor Trading.
scene.zh: Varga 廠長，這位是 Harbor Trading 的 Lantern 產品協調人。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Ms. Varga, Jack's told me so much about this factory.
scene.zh: Varga 廠長，Jack 跟我說了好多這間工廠的事。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome! Before we start, please put on this hard hat.
scene.zh: 歡迎！開始之前，請先戴上這頂安全帽。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I need to keep my hard hat on the whole time?
scene.zh: 安全帽需要一直戴著嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, the whole time. Safety comes first here.
scene.zh: 對，全程都要戴。在這裡安全第一。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let's start with the assembly line. It's busy today.
scene.zh: 我們從組裝線開始吧。今天很忙。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How many lamps are being assembled on this line today?
scene.zh: 這條線今天在組裝的燈有幾盞？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: About six hundred. One rolls off the line every minute.
scene.zh: 大約六百盞。每分鐘出來一盞。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Have all these components already been tested for safety?
scene.zh: 這些零件都已經做過安全測試了嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Every one of them. Come, our test lab is over here.
scene.zh: 每一個都測過了。來，我們的測試實驗室在這邊。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I didn't realize you had your own testing lab here.
scene.zh: 我都不知道你們這裡有自己的測試實驗室。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Our inspectors work there day and night.
scene.zh: 我們的檢驗員日夜都在裡面工作。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How often do you pull samples from the line for testing?
scene.zh: 你們多久從產線抽一次樣品來測試？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Every two hours. Look, they've found a crack in this base.
scene.zh: 每兩個小時一次。你看，他們在這個燈座上發現一條裂痕。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What matters most is that none of these reach our customers.
scene.zh: 最重要的是，這些一個都不能送到我們客戶手上。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Don't worry. This whole batch will stay here.
scene.zh: 別擔心，這整批都會留在這裡。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The good ones look great. Feel this wood.
scene.zh: 好的那些看起來很棒。摸摸這塊木頭。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: The natural wood base is what customers will notice first.
scene.zh: 天然木頭燈座會是客人第一眼注意到的地方。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The UK order is close to completion. Any other questions?
scene.zh: 英國的訂單快完成了。還有其他問題嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What's your daily output once the line is fully running?
scene.zh: 產線全面開工之後，你們每天的產量是多少？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: About twelve hundred. The new machines really improved our efficiency.
scene.zh: 大約一千兩百盞。新機器真的讓我們的效率提高很多。
